## ✨ What's new in 0.2.10

### 📁 Shared folders in the built-in Remote Desktop
- Folders and drives of this computer now show up on the remote computer under **This PC → Redirected drives and folders**, like in Remote Desktop Connection.
- Pick them in the host's settings under **Shared folders and drives**, or turn on **Share all local drives**.
- **Read-only** lets the remote computer open and copy files but not change or delete them.
- The remote side sees only the folders you shared: paths that lead outside them (`..`, links, junctions) are refused.

### 🖨️ Printers
- **Printers** in the host's settings now works in the built-in client: every printer of this computer is offered on the remote one, plus a **Terminyxx PDF** printer that opens the result here.
- **Printer drivers → Universal (PDF)** works with any server: it prints to PDF and this computer prints the PDF. **Same as on this computer** uses each printer's own driver, which the server must have.

### 📄 Files over the clipboard
- Drop local files on the remote desktop, or use **Send files** in the status bar or the full-screen bar, then paste them on the remote computer.
- Files you copy on the remote computer show a chip with **Save to…** to save them here.

### 🔐 Security
- **Saved passwords are encrypted under your master password.** With a master password set, passwords in the OS keychain are sealed with a key that exists only while Terminyxx is unlocked.
- While Terminyxx is locked, every action is refused, not just hidden behind the lock screen.
- A saved password is only ever sent to the saved host's address, user and port.
- Links in the terminal open only after you confirm them, and only `http`/`https` links open at all.
- Keyboard-interactive sign-in answers only password prompts with the saved password; any other question (such as a one-time code) is no longer answered with it.
- Importing a sync file turns off agent forwarding and tunnel auto-start on the imported hosts and tells you which existing hosts got a new address. Sync files over 64 MB are refused.
- The data folder and database are now private to your user account (macOS).
- Downloads keep the file permissions from the server, and Windows reserved names (`CON`, `NUL`…) are refused.
- When a host opens in Remote Desktop Connection, its saved credential is removed from Windows Credential Manager two minutes later instead of staying there.
- Releases are built with attested provenance: check a download with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo Intteger157/terminyxx`.

### 🛠 Fixes
- **Open folder** in the recordings library now opens the folder.
- The recordings library opens faster: it no longer reads every recording in full.
- Very large SFTP folders and host-monitor output from a server are now capped instead of growing without limit.

### Good to know
- The remote Explorer doesn't refresh a shared folder by itself yet: press `F5` after changing files on this computer.
- A session that keeps drawing but stops reacting while files are read usually means packets are lost on the way. A VMware virtual machine **bridged over Wi-Fi** did this; switching its network adapter to **NAT** fixed it.
